# Ayla

> Ayla is an astrology app for iPhone that holds you to what you said you
> wanted. Each day it reads your sky and ends with one small planned action.
> You plant it, it goes into your Garden, and weeks later Ayla asks what came
> of it. The math is computed from real astronomy; Ayla narrates, it never
> decides for you. Made in Los Angeles.

Key facts: iOS only. Pre-launch; the waitlist is open. No streaks. Three
modes: The Sun (you), The World (a friend), The Lovers (a partner); the other
person never needs the app. Ayla never promises that the sky delivers an
outcome. Contact: theaylaapp@icloud.com.
